sentences.text: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
**Scheme Brief Description:** Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (College Level) In the year 1994-95.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance

**Detailed Description:** In order to encourage tribal girl students of Rajasthan state to study in higher education and to promote girl education, financial assistance is provided to tribal girl students for higher education (college level).
**Benefits / Assistance:** - Annual financial assistance of Rs. 5,000/- is provided for 10 months at the rate of Rs.500/- per month.

**Application Process:** 1. Applicant to log in to [RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in) Portal using his/her SSOID.1. If SSOID is not available then the applicant to first [register ](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)on RajSSO Portal to create SSOID and update SSO Profile at first login.1. After successful authentication/login and updation of the SSOID Profile and select the scheme name. 1. Select his/her name, the bank account and fill in personal details. 1. Upload the required document. 1. Click the “SUBMIT” button.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Tribal Area Development Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, Higher Education, Educational Grant
